title: cert-issuer/sign output
description: Output Contract for cert-issuer/sign (CERT-2): the signed certificate, bound by the DELIVERY Step as {{.steps.<name>.outputs.certificate}}. Carries only PUBLIC material — the certificate and its serial. No private key appears here or anywhere on this path, because none was ever generated CLM-side (§2.5, ADR-0050): the target made the key, sent a CSR, and receives back the signature over it. `expiration` is informational for the Run's own log; the AUTHORITATIVE expiry the renewal Baseline reads is cert.expiry, projected by the CLM Syncer — one fact, one owner (§2.1).

serial.description: The issued certificate's serial — the cert.serial identity the CLM Syncer correlates on.

expiration.description: Unix expiry, informational. cert.expiry is the authoritative projection.
